capabilities: Read, create, replace, delete and search notes over localhost HTTP
Resolve wiki and markdown links to real vault paths
Serve and upload binary vault assets like images and PDFs
List daily-notes journal entries by date
List, create, update and delete macOS Reminders and Calendar events
extras: Fresh installs ship with a shared default API key (addwxfengshu4511) so clients connect out of the box; the README tells users to regenerate it if they see that as a risk. Reminders and Calendar endpoints work on macOS only and are off by default; the plugin is desktop-only.
motivation: The README doesn't state a motivation beyond pairing with the Note Tab Chrome new-tab extension for journals.
problem: Obsidian's Vault API is only usable inside the app, so external tools like browsers or scripts cannot read, create, edit or delete vault notes or resolve wiki links.

relations.evidence: Pairs with Note Tab, an Infinity-style Chrome new tab for your journals

requires.name: external HTTP client such as the Note Tab Chrome extension

summary: Localhost HTTP server that exposes vault notes, wiki-link resolution, asset serving and macOS Reminders/Calendar through an API-key-protected REST API.
